<?php
$shared = "7";
$pack = [&$shared, 20];
$snapshot = $pack;
$object = new class(...$pack) {
    public function __construct(int &$first, &$second) {
        echo $first === 7 ? "first-int|" : "bad-type|";
        $first = 9;
        $second = 30;
    }
};
echo $shared, "|", $pack[0], "|", $pack[1], "|";
echo $snapshot[0], "|", $snapshot[1], "|";
echo $snapshot[1] === 20 ? "copy-int|" : "changed|";

<?php
function late155Review() { echo "late|"; return 99; }
$pack = ["head" => "bad", 0 => 2];
try {
    $ordered = new class(...$pack, after: late155Review()) {
        public function __construct(int $head, ...$rest) { echo "order-body|"; }
    };
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo $error instanceof TypeError ? "type|" : "binding|";
    echo $error->getMessage(), "|";
}
echo "after-order|";
try {
    $duplicate = new class(...["head" => "bad"], head: late155Review()) {
        public function __construct(int $head, ...$rest) { echo "duplicate-body|"; }
    };
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo $error instanceof TypeError ? "type|" : "binding|";
    echo $error->getMessage(), "|";
}
echo "after|";

<?php
$parts155 = [2, 3];
echo "before|";
$object155 = new class(1, ...$parts155, last: 4) {
    public $sum;
    public function __construct(int $head, int ...$rest) {
        $rest[0] = 12;
        $this->sum = $head + $rest[0] + $rest[1] + $rest["last"];
    }
};
echo $object155->sum, "|", $parts155[0], "|", $parts155[1], "|after";

<?php
$source155 = 'namespace Ref155Author;
function make155() {
    $parts = ["third" => 3, "first" => 1];
    return new class(...$parts, last: 4) {
        public $sum;
        public function __construct(int $first, int $second = 20, int $third = 30, int $last = 40) {
            $this->sum = $first + $second + $third + $last;
        }
    };
}';
eval($source155);
$first155 = Ref155Author\make155();
$second155 = Ref155Author\make155();
echo $first155->sum, "|", $second155->sum, "|after";

<?php
function late155Author() { echo "late|"; return 7; }
echo "before|";
try {
    $object155 = new class(...1, later: late155Author()) {
        public function __construct(...$values) { echo "body|"; }
    };
} catch (TypeError $error155) {
    echo $error155->getMessage(), "|";
}
echo "after";

<?php
function make155Review() {
    return new class(...["8", 9]) {
        public $sum;
        public function __construct(int &$first, &$second) {
            echo $first === 8 ? "first-int|" : "changed-literal|";
            echo $second, "|";
            $first = 10;
            $second = 11;
            $this->sum = $first + $second;
        }
    };
}
$one = make155Review();
$two = make155Review();
echo $one->sum, "|", $two->sum, "|after";

<?php
function parts155NoCtor() { echo "parts|"; return [1, 2]; }
function late155NoCtor() { echo "late|"; return 3; }
echo "before|";
$object155 = new class(...parts155NoCtor()) { public $value = 7; };
echo $object155->value, "|";
try {
    $bad155 = new class(...["unknown" => 9], later: late155NoCtor()) {};
} catch (Error $error155) {
    echo $error155->getMessage(), "|";
}
echo "after";
